title: Right adjoint to proper étale derived direct image with finite coefficients
statement: Let X and Y be schemes and g : X → Y a proper morphism. Let Λ be a finite commutative ring. On the ordinary unbounded derived categories of étale sheaves of Λ-modules of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the total right derived functor Rg_* of the sheaf direct image admits a right adjoint. Neither X nor Y is assumed Noetherian or quasi-compact.

proof.text: The étale module-sheaf categories are Grothendieck abelian. Install their coproducts at the common indexing universe u+1. K-injective resolutions and these coproducts give coproducts of both unbounded derived categories by derived_hasCoproducts.

Derived inverse image F = Lg^* is a left adjoint via derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction, hence preserves coproducts. Its tensor-unit isomorphism is leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso. The source library theorem isIso_rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap_of_finite Λ g gives the unbounded proper projection formula for finite coefficients, the finite-ring specialization of Stacks Tag 0F0G. View it directly as an isomorphism of bifunctors via asIso; it requires no Noetherian or quasi-compact hypothesis.

Apply preservesCoproducts_of_projectionFormula to F = Lg^* and G = Rg_*. For every indexing set it first proves preservation of sums of copies of each object by tensoring the sum of units, then uses the copower retract argument to obtain all coproducts.

The existing triangulated right-derived-functor API gives exactness of Rg_*. Apply grothendieckDerived_hasRightAdjoint to this exact functor from the Grothendieck derived category, using the coproduct preservation just established. Its conclusion is precisely that Rg_* is a left adjoint, that is, admits a right adjoint.
